texts.zh:
我们对[Root.GetName]的竭泽而渔已经对环境造成了显著，乃至不可逆转的变化。工业污染引发的失控温室效应造成了严重的气候破坏。放射性物质的泄露更是导致大片[Root.GetPlanetMoon]区域不再宜居。

这种变化已经来到了关键的十字路口，除非我们改变开发手段，减少对星球环境的影响，不然的话就会遭受灭顶之灾，留下的将是一个不宜居且充满辐射的星球，星球上也会只剩波涛汹涌的海洋与死寂的不毛之地，如同预言末日的人们所给过的最恐怖的警告一般。
texts.en:
Our exploitation of [Root.GetName] has caused significant - perhaps irreversible - changes to the world's environment. Industrial pollution has caused significant climatic disruption via a runaway greenhouse effect, and rampant radioactive leaks have rendered large swaths of the [Root.GetPlanetMoon] uninhabitable by conventional means.

The process has now reached a tipping point. Unless we change our ways and start mitigating our impact on the planetary environment, we will be unable to prevent outright calamity: an inhospitable and irradiated world to match the worst of doomsayers' warnings, characterized by turbulent seas and unbroken lifeless wastelands.

texts.zh: 如果我们不采取措施，我们对[Target.GetName]的竭泽而渔会让当地成为一个死寂星球。我们必须决定对这个议题抱持什么态度：我们是要改变做法，还是说当下的情况是可接受的——甚至是期待中的——工业化进程中的代价？
texts.en: If we take no action, our exploitation of [Target.GetName] will rapidly render it a Tomb World. We must decide where we stand on this issue: will we have to change our ways, or is this an acceptable - or even desirable - price of industrial progress?

texts.zh: 现在对于[Target.GetName]环境的破坏已经达到了不可逆转的程度。我们已经无力阻止放射性废料遍布[Target.GetPlanetMoon]地表了。民众们对此无可奈何，因为需要努力实现下个月的生产目标，他们必须更加拼命地工作。
texts.en: The environmental damage to [Target.GetName] is now irreversible. Nothing we do can prevent the spread of radioactive waste across the [Target.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface. The response from the populace has been a great collective shrug as they bury themselves even deeper in their work, trying desperately to hit next month's productivity targets...

tooltips.zh: 现在更改局势的解决方案为时已晚。
tooltips.en: It is now too late to change our Approach to this Situation.

texts.zh: 现在对于[Target.GetName]环境的破坏已经达到了不可逆转的程度。我们已经无力阻止放射性废料遍布[Target.GetPlanetMoon]地表了。不幸的是，民众对此尤为不满，他们组织集会抗议我们的统治，并宣称是我们对于利益的过度追求“毁掉了一切”。
texts.en: The environmental damage to [Target.GetName] is now irreversible. Nothing we do can prevent the spread of radioactive waste across the [Target.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface. Unfortunately, the populace has not greeted this news with pleasure, organizing rallies against our leadership and complaining that our relentless pursuit of profit has "ruined everything".

label.zh: 他们无视了我们的优先战略目标，太遗憾了。
label.en: It is sad that they are blind to our priorities.

tooltips.zh: 在我们的行星沦为死寂星球时，我们会遭受低稳定度的惩罚。
tooltips.en: We will suffer low stability while our planets are turned into Tomb Worlds.

tooltips.zh: 现在更改局势的解决方案为时已晚。
tooltips.en: It is now too late to change our Approach to this Situation.

texts.zh: 我们孜孜不倦的清理工作将[Target.GetName]带离了毁灭灾厄的边缘。这个星球的气候稳定了下来，我们也从这个过程中学习到了足够的知识，确保类似的情况不会在未来复演，同时不会挫伤我们雄心勃勃的生产指标——尽管我们需要调配一些资源用于纾污花费。
texts.en: Our extensive cleanup efforts have brought [Target.GetName] back from the brink of disaster. The world's climate has now been stabilized, and we have learnt enough from the process to prevent this from happening in future without lowering our ambitious production targets - though we will have to set aside some resources as mitigation costs...

tooltips.zh: 我们的协同物流中心现在需要额外的£unity£ 凝聚力维护费。
tooltips.en: Our Coordinated Fulfillment Center will now cost additional £unity£ Unity Upkeep.

texts.zh: 环境改造已经完成：[Target.GetName]现在变成了一个贫瘠的、遍布辐射的废土。另一方面，更重要的是，我们的工业器械完全没有受到损伤，因此我们仍然可以达成自己的生产指标。没有什么比指标更重要的了。
texts.en: The transformation is complete: [Target.GetName] is now a barren, irradiated wasteland. More importantly, however, our industrial apparatus remains intact, so we are set to hit our production targets. Besides that, nothing else matters.

tooltips.zh: 我们的协同物流中心现在可以提供更大的工业产出增益。
tooltips.en: Our Coordinated Fulfillment Center will now provide even greater industrial output bonuses.

texts.zh: 环境改造已经完成：[Target.GetName]现在变成了一个贫瘠的、遍布辐射的废土。我们的[Owner.GetResearchers]已经透彻地研究了这一过程，并保证将该过程复制到其他星球上是完全安全的，但是仍然有部分人对我们为什么需要这项技术能力表示了忧虑。
texts.en: The transformation is complete: [Target.GetName] is now a barren, irradiated wasteland. Our [Owner.GetResearchers] have studied the process and promise they will be able to replicate it safely on other worlds, though some expressed unease as to exactly why we needed this ability.

texts.zh: 环境改造已经完成：[Target.GetName]现在变成了一个贫瘠的、遍布辐射的废土。我们的[Owner.GetResearchers]已经透彻地研究了这一过程，并保证只要有相关需求，我们就可以安全地将该过程复制到其他星球上。
texts.en: The transformation is complete: [Target.GetName] is now a barren, irradiated wasteland. Our [Owner.GetResearchers] have studied the process and promise they will be able to replicate it safely on other worlds, should we see the need.

tooltips.zh: 我们现在可以通过环境改造将行星转变为死寂星球。
tooltips.en: We may now terraform planets into Tomb Worlds.

summary.text:
# 无情的工业家 / Relentless Industrialists

- 分类 Category：银河轶事 C8 stories · 来源 Sources：events/toxoids_events.txt, common/situations/01_toxoid_situations.txt, common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

on_colony_yearly_pulse（common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:3934）触发 toxoids.1（events/toxoids_events.txt:10-133）：有协调履行中心（1级+1/年，故障+0.5，2级+2）的非特殊行星，所有者是“无情工业家”。变量达30后：若还没发生过情境，15–195天后 toxoids.5；已发生过则该行星直接变为墓地世界。
Accumulating pollution reaches 30: first time -> toxoids.5 and the situation; later times turn the planet into a Tomb World directly.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

toxoids.5 开启情境（初始进度50，双向）。态度：不作为/随它去（+2.5/月）、清理（−2.5/月）、拥抱变化。阶段：清理(≤50)、浩劫一(≤80，稳定−10)、浩劫二(≤100，稳定−20；首次进入时随机 1:4：toxoids.15 民众无所谓 / toxoids.10 民众抗议，若种族在墓地世界宜居则10不会出现)。
结局：进度归零 → toxoids.35 “恢复”；进度满 → 不作为 toxoids.25 “为了进步”（履行中心加强）/ 其他 toxoids.30 “变革的知识”（可制造墓地世界）。

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 10 / 15 互斥（随机）；35、25、30 互斥。

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 进入浩劫二后不能再改变态度。

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：toxoids.1-35 与情境。
